Monday, September 21.description:
Annual Yom Kippur Yizkor Service and Break the Fast Dinner hosted by Havurah Club. - Check-In: 5:30 – 5:55 PM - Yizkor Service: 6:00 PM (Independence Center – Freedom Hall) - Break the Fast Dinner: 6:45 – 7:00 PM start (Independence Center – Multipurpose Room)

The Yizkor Service will now take place in the Delaware Room at Anthem Center at 6:00 p.m. on Monday, September 21. Dinner will follow in the Arlington/Bristol/Concord Rooms, located directly behind the Delaware Room.

Check-in will be at the Delaware Room entrance. If you arrive after the Yizkor Service, please go to the Delaware entrance to get your table number, and then join us in the Arlington/Bristol/Concord Rooms for dinner.
